title: Windows 1.01
blurb: The MS-DOS Executive in EGA 640×350, from Windows 1.01's own floppy disk: there in 15 guest seconds.

title: Windows 2
blurb: The MS-DOS Executive in VGA, overlapping windows at last, from a hard disk with MS-DOS.

title: Windows 3.0

title: Windows 3.1

title: Windows 98
